verdict.rationale: No first-party docs describe how TeamViewer injects input, but community hands-on reports show users controlling remote desktops with it, such as logging into Windows and launching Steam on a host, which implies keyboard and mouse input is delivered. missing for 10: documentation that mouse, keyboard and scroll arrive as native OS events, any evidence on scroll handling or input fidelity (key mapping, modifiers, latency), independent detailed testing.

support.subject: As a power user, mouse, keyboard, and scroll input from the viewing device lands on the host as native events

citations.quote: runs TeamViewer on a single PC only to log into Windows and start Steam
even if you only want to control another desktop
